issue.title: submission_required=false with verified land-ready commit still fails commit finalizer with unpublished_local_commits
issue.description: On 2026-11-07 phase worker sase-1r2.6--2 held verified repair 48d0c3ea (109 goldens + capacity pin + gate wait, sase tool run check passed) with submission_required=false so no submit path, while commit finalizer failed the whole turn with unpublished_local_commits (finalizer_result.json + done.json outcome failed in artifacts/ace-run/202611/07/20261107104958/). Agent preserved the repair as bundle artifacts/ace-run/202611/07/20261107165558/visual-repair.bundle and staged monitor 3w69pb. Investigated 2026-11-12: master commit 1087ccd7f1 (fix(continuation): preserve local request provenance, sase-1sd.4) touches continuation/monitor/question/staged-handoff provenance only, not the commit-finalizer vs submission_required conflict, so it does not cover this defect.

task_type_fields.impact: Verified work cannot land through any sanctioned path, the turn fails, the repair survives only as a manual bundle, and the epic stalls until another agent takes over the landing.
task_type_fields.repro: Run a phase worker that creates a verified land-ready local commit while final context reports submission_required=false; host commit finalizer fails the turn with unpublished_local_commits (48d0c3ea at sase_10, restore hint push or reset --soft 8a9a993e); outcome failed, staged monitor 3w69pb never adopted.

issue.creation_reason: Phase worker held a verified land-ready repair but had no sanctioned landing path, then the turn failed; records the finalizer conflict the recovery plan exposed.
